scope: Core implementation with basic transient WebSocket continuation; not full OpenAI parity

routes.WebSocket /v1/responses: response.create, single default lane, explicit previous_response_id

defaults.store: must be explicitly false; omitted/null/true reject instead of downgrading storage

retention.responses: not retained; no HTTP retrieve or server-side HTTP chaining
retention.websocket: latest context in connection memory, evicted on close/failure/budget limit; replay after reconnect
retention.engine_caches: engine-owned KV/prefix caches; store:false is not a zero-data-retention promise
retention.telemetry: request/response IDs, timing, status and measured token usage; no prompt/output/tool arguments

deviations: Explicit store:false required for all Core requests, including WebSocket.
Local default output budget is 1024 tokens and is echoed; official service defaults are not assumed.
Usage detail objects are omitted when the engine does not measure/report them; no invented reasoning/cache counts.
Assistant phase cannot be represented faithfully by these model/template profiles and rejects before inference.
Schema support is the bounded listed subset; refs, recursion and unlisted constraints reject before inference.
Structured text formats cannot be combined with active function tools in one request; this combination rejects before tokenization/inference.
API keys are optional only for local development; configure API_KEY or API_KEYS to require Bearer authentication.

evidence.official_wire_differential: not run; source-derived fixtures and SDK helpers are not official wire certification
evidence.production: not certified: soak/load, crash/rolling restart and full release gates remain separate

release_gates.I02_assistant_phase: unsupported by admitted model/template profiles; P0 gap
release_gates.M05_live_engine_crash_restart: not run; client disconnect/reconnect tests are separate evidence
release_gates.M06_unified_memory_pressure: not run; model loaded and live inference alone are insufficient
